message.content:
Add AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) settings to the SEO admin panel in Rankora at /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/instantresumeranker.

## What AEO/GEO means for this feature:
- **AEO** = Answer Engine Optimization: optimizing for voice search (Siri, Alexa, Google Assistant) and featured snippets/direct answer boxes
- **GEO** = Generative Engine Optimization: optimizing for AI-powered search engines (ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Google SGE, Bing Copilot)

These are delivered via:
1. **FAQ structured data** (JSON-LD `FAQPage` schema) — critical for Google featured snippets and AI engines
2. **HowTo structured data** (JSON-LD `HowTo` schema) — helps AI engines understand the product workflow
3. **SpeakableSpecification** — marks which content is suitable for voice reading
4. **Citation/attribution meta** — `citation` meta tag, `author` meta tag for AI citation
5. **llms.txt** — a new standard (`/llms.txt`) for AI crawlers to understand site content
6. **Structured content description** — a rich plain-text description specifically for AI engines to use as citation text

## What to build:

### 1. Database migration
File: `supabase/migrations/20260319140000_add_aeo_geo_settings.sql`

Add columns to `seo_settings` table:
```sql
ALTER TABLE seo_settings
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS aeo_enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS aeo_speakable_enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS aeo_faq_json jsonb DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS geo_enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS geo_site_description_for_ai text DEFAULT '',
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS geo_author_name text DEFAULT '',
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS geo_author_url text DEFAULT '',
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS geo_citations_enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS geo_llms_txt text DEFAULT '';
```

### 2. New admin tab component
File: `src/components/admin/seo/AeoGeoTab.tsx`

A single tab with two sections: AEO and GEO.

**AEO Section:**
- Toggle: Enable AEO Optimizations
- Toggle: Enable Speakable (marks content for voice assistants)
- FAQ Manager: Add/edit/delete Q&A pairs (stored as JSON array `[{q: string, a: string}]`)
  - Add FAQ button → inline form with Question + Answer fields
  - List of existing FAQs with edit/delete
  - Preview shows the JSON-LD FAQPage schema

**GEO Section:**
- Toggle: Enable GEO Optimizations  
- Text area: "AI Description" — a rich plain-text description written specifically for AI engines (explains what the product does, target users, key features)
- Input: Author/Publisher Name
- Input: Author/Publisher URL
- Toggle: Enable Citation Meta Tags
- Textarea: llms.txt content (with a "Generate Default" button that creates a standard llms.txt from the site title, description, and canonical URL)
- Preview section showing the llms.txt content

Use the same card/collapsible pattern as other tabs. Use Save button with audit logging.

### 3. Update SeoHead.tsx
When `aeo_enabled`:
- Inject FAQ JSON-LD if `aeo_faq_json` has items:
  ```json
  {"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"FAQPage","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"...","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"..."}},...]}
  ```
- If `aeo_speakable_enabled`, add `speakable` property to WebApplication schema

When `geo_enabled`:
- Add `<meta name="citation_author" content="...">` if author set
- Add `<meta name="citation_publication_date" content="YYYY">` 
- Add `<meta name="description_ai" content="...">` with the AI description
- Add `<meta name="generator" content="Rankora">` (helps AI engines identify the platform)
- If `geo_citations_enabled`, also add `<meta name="citation_title" content="...">` and `<meta name="robots" content="max-snippet:-1, max-image-preview:large">` (allows AI engines to use full snippets)

### 4. Edge function: serve-llms-txt
File: `supabase/functions/serve-llms-txt/index.ts`

Reads `geo_llms_txt` from `seo_settings` and serves it at the endpoint. Falls back to a generated default if empty.

Add to `supabase/config.toml`: `[functions.serve-llms-txt]` with `verify_jwt = false`

### 5. Update SeoTab.tsx and the tab navigation
File: `src/components/admin/SeoTab.tsx`

Add "AEO / GEO" as a 7th tab in the navigation. Import and wire up AeoGeoTab.

### 6. Update useSeoSettings.tsx
Add the new fields to the `SeoSettings` interface.

## Code patterns to follow:
- Use `(supabase as any)` cast when querying seo tables (they're not in generated types)
- Import Button, Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, Label, Input, Textarea, Switch, Badge from their respective @/components/ui paths
- Use `toast.success()` / `toast.error()` from sonner
- Use `logAuditAction` from @/lib/auditLog for save actions: `logAuditAction("seo.update", "seo_settings", settings?.id, { section: "aeo_geo" })`
- Match the exact same pattern as RobotsTxtTab and SitemapTab for loading state (loaded flag + setLoaded)
- Run `npm run build` to verify no TypeScript errors

## After building:
1. Apply the DB migration via Management API: POST to https://api.supabase.com/v1/projects/zkzontawprihrzpayeam/database/query with Authorization: Bearer sbp_42c745b230bcc28c5e3063f80764470074b7b775
2. Deploy the new edge function: npx supabase functions deploy serve-llms-txt --project-ref zkzontawprihrzpayeam
3. Run npm run build to confirm zero errors
4. Run npm run test to confirm all 128+ tests still pass
